text:
maria: Heads up — CareWell (enterprise HIPAA customer) just signed the security addendum and legal asked for a full audit export (3 months) + KMS/HSM attestation by EOD. They want the raw audit trail (they'll handle redaction). Can someone own?

jenna: assigning to eng-support. do we have their tenant id + whether keys are CMK (customer-managed) or Redwood-managed?

maria: tenant: carewell-prod. Keys: customer-managed AWS KMS (cross-account). They also asked for HSM attestation for keys (they use an HSM-backed key in their AWS account). They said they already filed the addendum and need the export as proof for audit. timeline = COB today.

kevin: I can take HSM attestation side. Quick q: does CareWell expect us to pull logs from their S3 export, or produce a signed chain from our audit service? We have two paths.

maria: they explicitly requested our audit trail and a signed attestation that the audit export includes the KMS key IDs and HSM proof. They prefer a single package if possible.

alok: I'll try the export now. sharing repro steps I'm about to run so everyone sees logs.

alok: 
```
# attempt to export audit for tenant
redwood audit export --tenant carewell-prod --from 2025-11-01 --to 2026-02-28 --format ndjson --out /tmp/carewell-audit.ndjson
```

alok: result: fails with 403
```
Error: PermissionDenied: Access denied for KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345
    at AuditExport.run (/opt/redwood/bin/audit_export.js:142:23)
    caused by: kms:Decrypt denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-audit-exporter
```

maria: customer says they granted the cross-account/grant to role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-audit-exporter yesterday. they provided screenshots but we need to validate from our side.

kevin: common failure modes:
- Key grant didn't include kms:Decrypt or kms:DescribeKey
- Grant created but not rotated to include new principal (race)
- CMK in different account region than export job

alok: can someone from security confirm the expected role arn? our exporter runs under: arn:aws:iam::981234567890:role:redwood-audit-exporter-prod

jenna: @maria can you confirm the account id that created the grant? customer screenshot shows 123456789012 but our exporter running from 981234567890 — mismatch.

maria: confirmed: the grant was issued to 981234567890 in the screenshot, but the key owner account is 123456789012. I'm going to ask CareWell to re-run the grant with the exact principal string I send them.

kevin: also for HSM attestation: we need their AWS KMS key material metadata and an AWS CloudHSM attestation doc (if they used external key stores). I'll prepare the attestation template. attaching expected fields: key id, key origin, creation time, key state, keyPolicy, key usage, keySpec, rotation status, wrappingKey material sha256.

maria: customer also reported they saw a mismatch in retention window shown in Console vs. what's in their legal addendum. They think we are only keeping 30 days but addendum requires 6 years for audit metadata. They're anxious.

alok: retention mismatch likely because two things:
1) UI defaults show 'request logs' retention which is configurable per-tenant but we have separate 'audit metadata' retention in infra that's set to 6 years for HIPAA tenants.
2) if they have a Private deployment, their retention may be controlled by their infra team.

alok: I'll run a small check to confirm tenant config.

alok: 
```
# inspect tenant config
redwood tenant describe carewell-prod --fields retention.audit,retention.request
# sample output (prod):
retention.audit: P6Y
retention.request: P30D
```

alok: confirmed in config: audit retention = P6Y. so Console UI showing request logs (30d) is misleading. ops-runbook update needed.

jenna: ok action items so far:
- alok: finish audit export; investigate KMS 403 (owner: eng)
- kevin: draft HSM attestation template & sign-off process (owner: security)
- maria: coordinate with CareWell to reissue KMS grant principal and confirm they want raw ndjson
- jenna: prepare an email template for legal that confirms audit retention is 6 years in config (owner: cs)

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-4282: "CareWell audit export + HSM attestation (HIPAA addendum)" assigned to eng-support. Due: 2026-03-02 17:00 UTC

alok: update: CareWell applied a new grant referencing our exact principal and I re-ran the export.

alok: export now in progress, streaming to /tmp/carewell-audit-2026-03-02.ndjson

alok: progress: 45% — no KMS errors. copying chunked output to s3://redwood-exports/carewell/2026-03-02/

maria: can we include a manifest with checksums + signed hash for the package? customer asked for tamper-evident packaging.

kevin: yes. we'll produce a signed manifest using our signing key (org-attest-2026). Steps:
1) compute sha256 for each ndjson file
2) produce manifest.json with entries
3) sign with org-attest-2026 and include signature.sig

kevin: note: signature process requires our HSM key (not the customer's). legal is ok with Redwood-signed attestation.

jenna: I'll draft the cover note for legal: include statement that audit metadata retention is configured to 6 years (P6Y) and attach the manifest + HSM attestation.

maria: customer also asked: do redwood logs contain any plaintext PHI? we should be explicit.

kevin: short answer: request/response bodies are not stored in audit metadata. audit entries contain request IDs, model used, timestamps, and auth principal. For HIPAA tenants we have an option to include request hashes only. I'll add explicit language.

alok: export complete. uploaded artifacts:
- s3://redwood-exports/carewell/2026-03-02/carewell-audit-2026-03-02.ndjson.gz
- s3://redwood-exports/carewell/2026-03-02/manifest.json
- s3://redwood-exports/carewell/2026-03-02/manifest.sig

alok: checksum (manifest): sha256: 8f3b2a... (truncated)

maria: great. I'm preparing the package to send to CareWell legal. I'll include the HSM attestation from kevin once ready.

kevin: attestation draft attached to INF-4282. I'll sign and upload by EOD.

jenna: closing loop: update runbook to clarify Console label for "request log retention" vs "audit metadata retention" (docs ticket DOCS-912). Also add quick checklist for on-demand audit export for HIPAA customers.

maria: thanks team. CareWell legal replied: confirmed receipt pending review. I'll mark INF-4282 as awaiting customer sign-off.

alok: note for postmortem: we should surface the KMS principal mismatch in the exporter errors with clearer guidance (e.g., "Grant principal mismatch: expected arn:... got arn:..."). filing a dev ticket.

deploy-bot: Created ticket ENG-5241: "Improve audit export KMS error messaging" assigned to eng-runtime.

jenna: awesome. I'll follow up with customer tomorrow AM to confirm final acceptance.
